$comment: Openings of a model's reply ABOUT a translation request instead of a translation (ZecHub/zechub#2467). One list, read by scripts/check-model-replies.mjs in CI and by the translation runner at write time, so the two cannot drift apart. Each pattern is a JavaScript regular expression, matched case-insensitively against the START of a prose line after its Markdown markers (heading #, list bullet, quote >, table pipe). English on purpose: a translation into one of our locales never opens a line with these, and a line the English page itself contains is never flagged.

patterns.re: ^i (?:cannot|can ?not|can['’]t|am unable to|['’]m unable to|won['’]t|will not|am not able to)\b
